responsibility: This definition file is the master catalogue of GCC internal functions (IFN_*). It declares each internal operation's name, ECF flags, optional fnspec, and—when applicable—the direct optab mapping style that tells GCC how to infer operand/result modes and generate expanders. It is the authoritative table from which the compiler builds enums, metadata arrays, support predicates, and expander dispatch for compiler-synthesized call-like GIMPLE operations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/internal-fn.h and gcc/internal-fn.cc, this .def file is the declarative source list of IFN_* entries and their metadata macros, consumed to generate enums, tables, and expander bindings rather than providing APIs or executable logic directly.
